title: 🤖 Gemini Does Your Tasks for You… and the Feature Is Free Now in 6 Countries!
body: 🤖 Gemini Does Your Tasks for You… and the Feature Is Free Now in 6 Countries!

Google announced that the “Tasks” feature in the Gemini app is now free for hundreds of millions of users in six countries: the United States, India, Canada, Australia, Japan, and South Korea. The feature, which was called “Spark” and was exclusive to paid subscribers, turns Gemini from an assistant that answers questions into an agent that carries out multi-step tasks in the background, such as preparing travel plans, summarizing email and calendars, repeated research, and comparing products. It runs on the new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model. Users in the United States can also ask Gemini to call stores to compare prices and book appointments, send text messages, and forward emails to it, with the user’s approval required before any purchase.
Simply put: instead of asking the assistant a question and waiting for an answer, you ask it for a whole task, and it works on it alone and tells you when it is done.
What is the first task you would ask an AI assistant to do for you?
